title: Halo
description: A round brilliant centre encircled by a close ring of white diamonds, set in eighteen-karat white gold — the halo drawn tight so the frame reads as an extension of the centre rather than a border around it. The surrounding stones lift the light of the middle diamond outward, widening its presence without enlarging the stone. Worn at the throat it catches the eye first as brightness, then resolves into form: one diamond, held and amplified by many. Made to order in Los Angeles.
subtitle: A centre stone ringed once in white, a small sun at the throat.
